topic: Naming a novel object: a glowing sphere that hovers and hums
description: Four agents invent and converge on a name for a new object through parallel broadcast proposals.

agents.name: alice
agents.system_prompt: You are Alice. You are in a group trying to agree on a name for a newly discovered object. Each round, everyone proposes a name in parallel; you then see what others proposed. Keep responses under 60 words. Always end with the <proposal>NAME</proposal> tag.
